text:
Anika: proposing a new multimetric promote window for v4-int4 bring-up — want to lock down auto-fallback triggers before we open traffic.
Mike: +1. what metrics are we bundling? latency + quality?
Anika: yes. thinking p99 latency, longform ROUGE-L delta, and embedding drift (cosine) for reranker tasks. all three must pass.
Sara: can we make it a soft pass for ROUGE and hard for latency? int4 sometimes has tiny ROUGE dips but still acceptable.
Anika: agreed — soft tolerance for ROUGE (-0.8% relative) but require p99 <= 120ms and embedding drift < 0.01. fail any hard -> immediate rollback.
Jon: how many samples and window length?
Anika: propose promote_window = 30m, min_samples = 500, min_unique_users = 200. also require stability across two contiguous windows to avoid noisy flips.
Mike: paste of the gate config I sketched: ```
{
  "promote_window": "30m",
  "min_samples": 500,
  "min_unique_users": 200,
  "checks": {
    "p99_latency_ms": {"threshold": 120, "mode": "hard"},
    "rouge_l_rel_pct": {"threshold": -0.8, "mode": "soft"},
    "embed_cosine_drift": {"threshold": 0.01, "mode": "hard"}
  },
  "require_consecutive_windows": 2
}
```
Sara: looks good. for soft ROUGE we need auto-alert to SLO channel if it drifts beyond -0.3% before hitting -0.8%. catch early.
Eva: ran quick A/B on 1h sample for docs-long slice: control fp16 v3.1 vs candidate v4-int4adv. summary: control ROUGE-L 0.421, candidate 0.417 (delta -0.95%). p99 latency control 110ms, candidate 98ms. embed cosine mean drift 0.007.
Jon: so ROUGE delta is slightly worse than soft threshold (-0.95% < -0.8%). that should block promote unless we widen soft window.
Anika: agree. but sample size small; can we run quiet-burn for next 4h with 5% traffic and evaluate two windows?
Mike: scheduled quiet-burn in staging -> will mirror production slice and run comparison. @ci-bot will push the canary config.
ci-bot: canary job queued: canary-id=canary-2026-03-21-1792, traffic=5%, duration=4h. will report metrics to /promote-reports.
Sara: add additional eval: semantic similarity on Q/A samples (F1) — int4 sometimes hurts short answer fidelity.
Eva: added. also recommend enabling prefix KV cache for candidate to reduce coldstart p99 variability.
Jon: question on auto-fallback behavior: do we fallback to fp16 v3.1 or to a safer int8 variant?
Anika: fallback order: exact pinned previous version (fp16 v3.1) then int8 safe variant if pinned fallback fails. config will have failover_priority list.
Mike: I'll update rollout policy and add the soft-alert thresholds. will open PR with config and runbook.
Sara: assign me to the runbook review.
Anika: thanks — target to flip promote_window to live tomorrow after 4h quiet-burn and PR merge. :thumbsup:
Eva: note — if ROUGE delta persists but other metrics fine, we might still promote with a targeted A/B for long-doc users only. decide after quiet-burn.
Jon: agree. keep guardrails strict for global promote, flexible for slice-based routing.
Anika: great. I'll post results from canary job when ci-bot completes.
ci-bot: canary job started. logs -> https://ci/redwood/canary-1792/logs (will update with metrics).
